findings.title: In-progress drag survives a settings-panel open/close — release after close commits the draw at the new cursor position
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin (S collected when sel_pipe<0 mid-drag; exec Toggle_Settings never cancels drag; releases suppressed only WHILE panel_open)
findings.evidence: mouse.odin: 'if inp.panel_open { // suppressed — the panel owns the surface } else if drag_eff && placing_eff < 0 { ... Drag_Release }' — drag.active is never cleared on open; after close the drag branch resumes with drag_eff true.
findings.detail: S is collectible mid-drag (sel_pipe<0 during a fresh draw); the modal suppresses releases but preserves the armed drag across the cycle — a stale gesture commits late.
findings.recommended_fix: Cancel the drag (Cancel_Drag) when the panel opens, or clear drag on close.
